title: Convergence of Riemannian Stochastic Gradient Descents: Varying Batch Sizes And Nonstandard Batch Forming
summary: We establish convergence theorems for Riemannian stochastic gradient descents in which the underlying probability spaces vary from iteration to iteration. As applications, we deduce convergence results for Riemannian stochastic gradient descents with varying batch sizes and unbiased batch forming schemes.
